summary: Thomas posted 'Free Palestine' on X on August 23, 2026, pledging to call for an immediate ceasefire and restore USAID funding. Three days later she ran anti-AIPAC campaign material, filming herself discarding a bin labeled 'AIPAC Funds' and calling herself a 'sole grassroots candidate' rejecting such money. Vote for Peace, a human-rights and war-lobby funding rating guide, rated her an Ally in the general-election phase.
